plugins.description: Design distinctive, high-craft frontends and animate them smoothly. Bundles a style-agnostic design method, five reference-backed style lenses (editorial, Swiss/minimal, brutalist, luxury, portfolio), 60fps React animation best practices, interactive WebGL/3D (react-three-fiber), responsive/fluid layout that never breaks on mobile, and a revenue-centric design playbook for conversion, onboarding, pricing, and retention.
